description: This source file implements a module for controlling speech-to-text (STT) muting based on various strategies and conversation states. It defines classes and logic to manage muting during function calls, bot speech, and custom conditions, including a deprecated filter class that suppresses VAD frames when muted.

classes.name: STTMuteStrategy
classes.description: Enumeration of strategies for muting STT during different conversation states.

classes.name: STTMuteConfig
classes.description: Configuration dataclass for specifying muting strategies and optional custom callback.

classes.name: STTMuteFilter
classes.description: A deprecated processor class that manages STT muting and interruption control based on conversation frames.

methods.name: __post_init__
methods.description: Validates the muting strategies set in the configuration to prevent incompatible combinations.

methods.name: _handle_mute_state
methods.description: Handles changing the muting state and logs the change.

methods.name: _should_mute
methods.description: Determines whether STT should be muted based on current strategies and conversation state.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames to update muting state and suppresses frames when muted.
